# Adelaide MedTech Hackathon 2026
> A four-day, student-led event focused on healthcare innovation running from August 19-22, 2026.

## Site Information
- **Domain:** https://adelaidemedtech.com
- **Developed by:** Muhammad Ahmad, Media Director

## Key Sections
- [About Us](https://adelaidemedtech.com/#about): The history of the club and our mission.
- [Schedule](https://adelaidemedtech.com/#schedule): Full itinerary and workshop timings.
- [Registration](https://adelaidemedtech.com/#register): How to sign up and form teams.
